docs.summary: Axis gizmo drawn in the corner of the scene view. The three positive axes are labelled arrows, the three negative ones are plain rings, and clicking any of them puts the camera on that side of the scene looking back at it.
True while the cursor is over the widget, so the caller can hold off camera drags.

Set by the last [`Update`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Gizmo.ViewManipulatorGizmo~Update) when the click landed on the widget but not on a handle. The caller decides what that means; the scene view swaps the camera's projection.
